request.auth: static token X-Token default; attachment static-only. Ticket explicit account IAM X-Auth-Token alternative matches operation schema but general auth table conflicts, deployment compatibility unconfirmed; never automatic fallback.
request.validation: source required/nullability/enums/string/array/ranges/UUID rules before credential/HTTP; exact service/generation/scope/endpoint and explicit parent; protected typed values reveal only at private wire boundary; no generation fallback

200.description: The number of tickets has been returned.

response.mapping: generated source DTOs including inherited/inline/nullable shapes; exact integers; source-optional zero/false distinct from absence, explicit nullable null retained; source ID scanned before independent decoding; source ref injection ignored; free text, URLs, unknown extensions protected
response.identity: ticket number/comment ID/file UUID from acknowledged response only; exact caller refs retained on errors; comments keep caller-provided ticket parent, ticket_number metadata never manufactures parent; foreign identities rejected

errors.mapping: shared sanitized HTTP status mapping; opaque provider message/errors/validation data never diagnostics; default does not establish rejection; only documented operation rejections or common auth401 prove rejection

retry.mutations: no replay, including lost response, cancellation, 500, auth retry and multipart body; known references require exact observation

receipt: all mutations finalize not_sent/accepted/rejected/unknown on every path; accepted HTTP does not prove user goal; source comment create keeps ticket anchor plus independently acknowledged child ref; never name lookup/adoption

recovery.contract: exact-reference observation only; unknown outcomes remain indeterminate, no automatic replay; resource ACL/content/vote/AV readiness is not inferred from existence
recovery.receipt_bound: validate operation/contract revision/endpoint/scope/exact target and filter originating capability.WaitGoals; comment create selects only acknowledged comment with exact caller parent anchor
recovery.goals: v2 known raw status keys; v1 closed/open goals require explicit is_closed true/false, missing stays unknown; comment/file metadata observation requires source ID, never AV clean/download or support reply readiness

pagination.contract: common bounded options and operation/scope/endpoint/revision/filter fingerprints; exact partial-page replay; provider envelope duplicate rows removed; fixed complete source responses only for nonpaginated taxonomy/comments/topics; legacy page_count proof when present; no inferred end for unconfirmed variants

transfer.upload: typed multipart field data, caller filename/MIME/actor UUID, exact finite size; do not probe beyond caller bytes or close caller reader; synchronous response decoder owns once-close response; bytes on every return reports consumed input, not server persistence; accepted201 trustworthyfileUUID retained on decode errors
transfer.download: unavailable before I/O until successful contract confirmed; no guessed200/302, no arbitrary signedURL follow

limitations: Whole service inventory incomplete/coverage_ratio null; offline tests do not establish live deployment or alternative IAM availability; no real tickets/messages/contact/upload/download performed
